purpose: Edit a local date/time string with an explicit displayed interpretation zone while leaving instant resolution to the host.
behaviorProvider: Native input type=datetime-local through Aegis TextInput; Intl validates supported zone identifiers.

component: Keep offset-free local date/time strings such as 2027-04-12T09:30 in a native datetime-local input. Never convert them to Date objects, offsets or UTC instants.

Require timeZone as local or an Intl-supported named zone; reject empty, unsupported and numeric-offset identifiers. Display the policy in a description associated with the input. timeZoneLabel can localize the entire explanation.

Pass min/max/step and inherited TextInput native props, value callbacks, ref, disabled/readOnly and name/form through. Merge the visible zone description with explicit and enclosing Field descriptions.
host: Resolve the entered wall time with the declared zone, including ambiguous or nonexistent daylight-saving times. Own zone changes, instant conversion, validation, storage and scheduling semantics; local explicitly means the device zone.

Supply a visible label, enclosing Field label or accessible name. Use useful host validation and recovery instructions instead of relying on placeholder text.

Owned styling consumes input group tokens. Actual nested shared components retain their own token groups. Preserve keyboard-visible focus and equivalent size metrics across the four theme/mode mappings.

limitations: This source-backed requirement record does not certify a current test result or release approval.
Zone identifier support depends on the runtime Intl data. Displaying a zone does not make the native picker timezone-aware.
No calendar range, instant conversion or DST gap/overlap resolution is provided. Native presentation varies by browser.
